drafts.title: Grace
drafts.pitch: The user's family is going round the table saying what they're thankful for, and Cursor's turn takes so long they start eating.
drafts.reason: Funny 6, clear 8, in-world 8, fresh 5. Cursor's escalating gratitude list and Tilde's 'Thankful for that.' work, but token blocks burying an over-eager Cursor repeats Be Concise and Thinking, so freshness caps it.

drafts.title: Small Talk
drafts.pitch: The user wants no task, just a chat, and Cursor can't find anything to do with that.
drafts.reason: Funny 5, clear 6, in-world 8, fresh 7. The emptiest room with Cursor's cursor shrunk to a dot is a good image, but the silent standoff reads as a mood rather than a joke.
